description.value:
The Sentinel occupies the middle ground between the Guardian and the Consular, wielding a unique two-thirds Force casting progression that lets them blend blade work and Force power more evenly than either of their counterparts. Sentinels are watchers and problem-solvers: investigators, wardens, and quiet enforcers who use the Force to see what others miss and to end a threat before it escalates.

A Sentinel's guiding Sentinel Ideals — the personal code that shapes their approach to duty — determine whether they lean toward stealthy interdiction, relentless pursuit, or unshakeable vigilance, but every Sentinel shares the same core versatility: enough martial skill to win a fight and enough Force power to make sure it never needed to happen.
